data.body: Cluster RC-A fix opened as PR #103 https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/103. This ticket is RC-B (reviewer prompt calibration) and remains open as a follow-up. RC-A landing reduces recurrence of these findings but does not address the per-finding hallucinations/severity-inflation root cause — that requires a separate fix bundle (F4: structured verification_evidence field in reviewer prompts; F5: post-LLM grep validator in runner.py; F6: rubric anchors for state-transition test reuse and public-config trust-boundary claims).
